items.q: Does producing more always increase profit?
items.correct: No — overproduction raises costs and waste if it isn't sold.
items.misconception: Yes, more output always means more profit.
items.why: Profit depends on selling at a margin and controlling costs and quality, not just volume.

items.q: Why does a business motivate its staff?
items.correct: Motivated staff are more productive and stay longer.
items.misconception: Motivation has no effect on performance.
items.random_wrong: Only pay can ever motivate workers.
items.why: Motivation (pay and non-pay factors) raises productivity and reduces staff turnover.
